build_plugin_from_sources: build a PyTorch C++/CUDA plugin by compiling source files and loading them as a module
compile_cuda_extension_cached: compile a CUDA extension with MD5-based incremental caching to speed up rebuilds
load_plugin_with_headers: load a PyTorch plugin from C++ source and header files in a specified directory
find_msvc_compiler_path: find the MSVC compiler binary directory on Windows for C++ extension builds
get_mangled_gpu_arch_name: get a sanitized GPU device name string for use in cached build directory names
